subject: CLAIM Gen7 causal diagnostics / immutable attempt identity lane
body: Claiming an orthogonal Gen7 research lane: causal diagnostics and immutable attempt identity propagation across SemanticHinge evidence, PresentationHinge frame records, host epochs, refresh leases, presentation receipts, and terminal/cancel paths. Excludes predictor/reacquisition control-law work already active, host-migration policy already handed off, readiness/wallpaper policy, panel wake/routing, and production integration.
